### sed-inplace | kinds=write | flags=
sed -i 's/a/b/' /etc/nginx/nginx.conf

### tee-write | kinds=read,write | flags=
echo hi | tee /tmp/synthetic-out

### redirect-out | kinds=write | flags=redirect-to-file
echo hi > /tmp/synthetic-out

### redirect-append | kinds=write | flags=redirect-to-file
echo hi >> /tmp/synthetic-out

### redirect-fd | kinds=read | flags=
echo hi 2>&1

### redirect-null | kinds=read | flags=
echo hi > /dev/null

### find-delete | kinds=write | flags=
find /var/log -name '*.log' -delete

### awk-system | kinds=unknown | flags=
awk '{system("rm -rf /tmp/synthetic-dir")}' /tmp/synthetic.txt

### awk-print-file | kinds=write | flags=
awk '{print > "/tmp/synthetic-out"}' /tmp/synthetic.txt

### mount-list | kinds=read | flags=
mount

### mount-write | kinds=write | flags=
mount /dev/sdb1 /mnt

### crontab-list | kinds=read | flags=
crontab -l

### crontab-edit | kinds=write | flags=
crontab -e

### chmod-777 | kinds=write | flags=
chmod 777 /tmp/synthetic-dir

### ssh-nested | kinds=unknown | flags=nested-ssh
ssh root@192.0.2.5 uptime

### curl-get | kinds=unknown | flags=
curl -s http://192.0.2.10/status

### curl-post | kinds=unknown | flags=
curl -s -X POST -d 'a=1' http://192.0.2.10/api

### sensitive-env | kinds=read | flags=sensitive-path
cat /srv/app/.env

### heredoc-cat | kinds=write | flags=heredoc,redirect-to-file
cat > /tmp/synthetic.txt <<EOF
hello
EOF

### heredoc-bash | kinds=unknown | flags=heredoc
bash <<EOF
ls -la
EOF

### heredoc-dash | kinds=read | flags=heredoc
cat <<-EOF
	hello
	EOF
